$comment: Machine-readable index of every change made to this repository.
Read by scripts/revert_change.py, which uses it to show, verify and undo
any individual change. Kept in step with CLAUDE_CHANGES.md by hand:
the Markdown file is the narrative, this file is the index.
id          - stable change identifier, never reused
commit      - the commit that introduced it ('' until committed)
tag         - git tag pointing at that commit
reversible  - how it can be undone:
'flag'  - switch it off at runtime, no code change
flag        - the setting name when reversible by flag
risk        - what breaks if this is reverted
